## How to read the tables

- **Permission** is what the connection must be allowed to do. **Read** is always granted. **Organize and draft** changes things inside Maylee (labels, drafts, rules, settings) and never sends anything. **Send** acts outside the mailbox: sending, scheduling, unsubscribing, auto-forwarding, automatic replies. A connection only lists the tools its permissions allow.
- **confirm**: the tool refuses to act without `confirm: true`, which the assistant must only set after you approved that exact action. Without it, the call returns a summary to show you.
- **confirm in some cases**: the same, only for the risky cases (for example more than 10 emails moved to Trash, or turning on Auto-Reply).
- **idempotency key**: the call needs an `idempotencyKey`, so a retry after a timeout never sends twice. Creation tools accept an optional one.
- **OAuth only**: the tool acts for a person, so it is hidden when the server is used with an API key.
- **hourly budget**: the tool counts against one of the hourly safety budgets of the connection (sends and recipients, emails moved to Trash or Spam, AI generations).

## Prompts

Guided workflows, shown in the `/` menu of clients such as Claude. They change nothing by themselves: they tell the assistant which tools to chain, and to ask you before acting.

| Prompt | Description | Arguments |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `triage_inbox` | Walk through the unread inbox, summarize it by importance, and propose labels, reply drafts and emails to trash. Nothing is changed before the user approves. | `mailboxId` (optional), `maxEmails` (optional) |
| `follow_up_waiting_for_reply` | List sent emails that are still waiting for a reply after some days, and draft polite follow-ups for the user to approve. | `olderThanDays` (optional) |
| `set_up_ai_labels` | Interview the user about how they want their email sorted, then propose AI label rules (names, colors, conditions, options) and create them after approval. | `goal` |

## Resources

The reference data used by the tools, one Markdown resource per topic. `get_reference` returns the same content.

| Resource | Title | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `maylee://reference/overview` | Maylee in a nutshell | What a Maylee workspace contains and how the tools are organized. |
| `maylee://reference/label_colors` | Label colors | The seven label color names accepted by Maylee and how they render. |
| `maylee://reference/view_icons` | View icons | A view icon is one emoji; the 48 emojis offered by the app picker. |
| `maylee://reference/view_filters` | View and email filter grammar | The filter grammar used by `create_view`, `update_view` and `list_emails` filters. |
| `maylee://reference/ai_label_rules` | AI label rules | Every option of an AI label rule: condition, Auto-Draft, Auto-Reply, threshold, delay, notifications, hide from inbox. |
| `maylee://reference/auto_forward_rules` | Auto-forward rules | Condition fields and modes of auto-forward rules, and when they run. |
| `maylee://reference/inbox_filters` | Inbox filters | Inbox filter types (sender, domain, subject, label) and their effect. |
| `maylee://reference/snippet_icons` | Snippet icons | Icon names accepted for snippets (smart links). |
| `maylee://reference/folders_and_views` | Folders and system views | Maylee folders and built-in lists (waiting for reply, scheduled, hidden by filters). |
| `maylee://reference/scheduling` | Scheduling | How scheduled sends work: local time format, allowed range, statuses. |
| `maylee://reference/limits` | Limits and quotas | Rate limits, monthly quotas, bulk sizes, hourly safety budgets and field sizes. |
| `maylee://reference/permissions` | Permissions | Read, write and send permissions and how to get them. |
| `maylee://reference/security` | Safety rules | How to handle untrusted email content and irreversible actions. |
